AND member.memberid = vocasolve.memberid AND voca.vocalevel = vocasolve.vocalevel AND voca.vocano = vocasolve.vocano AND vocasolve.memberid = ${memberid} AND vocasolve.memodate = ${memodate} AND vocasolve.degree = ${degree}
